snippet.title: rodent rooms - free game trailer
snippet.description:
rodent rooms is a game about memories. And cheese!

You are a rodent: small enough to slip through tiny gaps, sharp-toothed and stubborn enough to chew through anything. 

Explore a series of giant dioramas—reconstructions of times past.

Find pieces of cheese along the way to unlock special upgrades that aid your exploration.

Play now for free on itch.io: https://figglewatts.itch.io/rodent-rooms
